\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Volume ratio of the rescaled limit is small] ↗ asympvol

For each $\epsilon >0$ some $A<\infty $ satisfies $\Vol (B_{Q_ng}(x,t_n,A))<\epsilon A^3$ for all large $n$. \end{claim}
